titleZh: 分享背景 · 竖版上下内容空间
spec: Create a PORTRAIT 1536 x 2048 background, exactly 3:4, for a later share-image composition. Give the broad central body quiet pale icy-cyan atmosphere; the upper central zone around x=12%..88%, y=10%..52% can take a character/card image, and the lower central zone around x=12%..88%, y=55%..89% can take description and dimension bars. These two areas must connect organically as one calm background, NOT look like two drawn rectangular cards or framed panels. No distracting skyline or strong horizon passing through the middle of either quiet area. This is one flexible city background, no text or layout objects.
